csv_project_name: Engineering for Traffic Signal Timing Optimization
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Bellaire, Texas, herein City , seeks an agreement with a qualified individual, firm, or Corporation, herein Respondent , to provide professional engineering services for TRAFFIC SIGNAL TIMING OPTIMIZATION. The City is seeking qualifications from firms with experience with traffic signal optimization programs. The result of this RFQ will lead to one (1) contract with a firm or a team of firms. The purpose of this project is to develop and implement a traffic signal optimization program throughout the City. The study shall gather and analyze data of existing travel times and traffic signal timing; perform field observations; develop optimized traffic signal timing plan with optimized time-space diagrams and offset/split tables; research, analyze, recommend, procure, and install traffic signal timing optimization software that can be integrated into Bellaire Traffic Management Center;
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Planning/Master Planning, Electrical Engineering, ITS Design, Traffic Design Engineering
